name: Vapin Ape Full Spectrum Pod 3pk | Variety Pack (AM, BCK, PH)
description:
Animal Mints, Black Cherry Mints, Pineapple Haze Pods. Our proprietary oil formulations are uniquely blended to ensure a consistent, lasting-high. Solventless, high-terpene extract is the driver behind this full spectrum oil that delivers a "flower-like" experience for the user.Because each of our vapes are strain-specific, with unique terpene profiles, the consumer has the power to choose their experience.

Three pack of 1.0G pods, compatible with Vapin Ape Standard Smart Battery.
